source_note: Chinese hot-topic candidates are collected from public trend pages; English wording is matched to supplied official English headlines when possible, otherwise suggested neutrally.

topics.why_hot: A reported earthquake in Jiyuan is drawing national attention and raising public concern about safety and emergency response.
topics.share_angle: Use it for a quick, location-based explainer on how earthquake reports spread in China and how users can follow official updates.

topics.why_hot: Apple’s fall product event is a globally followed tech moment, and Chinese users are watching closely for new device details.
topics.share_angle: Can be framed as a global tech story with useful context on why Apple launches attract so much attention in China.

topics.why_hot: The Zheng Qinwen matchup is a major sports trending topic because Chinese sports fans are closely following her performance.
topics.share_angle: Can be covered as a match preview or recap with context on China’s growing tennis audience.

topics.why_hot: The date is Teachers’ Day in China, and many users are sharing greetings, stories, and reflections on teachers.
topics.share_angle: A cultural moment that lets you explain the role of teachers in China and compare it with similar observances abroad.

topics.chinese_topic: 高考数学132入学考试0分 大学回应
topics.official_english: University Responds to Zero on Entrance Assessment Despite High Gaokao Math Score
topics.why_hot: The huge gap between a high gaokao math score and a zero on a later assessment prompts debate about how universities test students.
topics.share_angle: Great for explaining the gaokao-to-university transition and questions about exam preparation versus college readiness.

topics.chinese_topic: 资助者回应被资助女孩质问没打生活费

topics.why_hot: The topic stirs discussion about expectations, communication, and responsibilities in person-to-person student sponsorship.
topics.share_angle: Useful for a broader social-values story about informal charity in China and the emotional dynamics it can create.

topics.chinese_topic: 降价140万元的药终于有患者用了
topics.official_english: Drug Reduced by 1.4 Million Yuan in Price Finally Used by Patients
topics.why_hot: A very expensive drug becoming more accessible after a huge price cut makes medical affordability a leading public-interest topic.
topics.share_angle: Can explain why high-cost treatments are difficult to access and how price reductions can change patient outcomes.

topics.chinese_topic: 明年或爆发全球粮食危机
topics.official_english: Global Food Crisis Could Erupt Next Year
topics.why_hot: A widely shared warning about potential food shortages makes users pay attention to prices, supply chains, and global risks.
topics.share_angle: Can be framed as an international explainer on food security risks and why they matter beyond any single country.
